subject: ela
intro: Fifth graders include multimedia components (graphics, sound, video) and visual displays in presentations when appropriate to enhance the development of main ideas or themes. Good media match the topic, support the main point, and help the audience understand. A visual is seen; audio is heard.

items.prompt: You are presenting on renewable energy. Which visual would ENHANCE your main idea: a diagram showing how a wind turbine works, or a photo of your lunch?

steps: A good visual supports the main idea.
A diagram of a wind turbine is about renewable energy.
So the diagram enhances the presentation.
solution.answer: A diagram showing how a wind turbine works.

items.prompt: You present on different musical instruments. What multimedia could help the audience?

steps: Audio clips let the audience hear the instruments.
So short audio clips of the instruments would help.
solution.answer: Short audio clips of the instruments.

items.prompt: To COMPARE the energy output of three power sources, which visual is best: a bar graph or a poem?

steps: So a bar graph is best for comparing output.

items.prompt: Something the audience SEES is a ____.
A good visual should ____ the main idea.
